sourceText:
Very French French Toast
By: Nuts about food
Published: Monday, December 13, 2010 - 3:04am

Ingredients




Ingredients (from the Joy of Cooking)
8 slices of Sally Lunn or other sweet bread (like challah or brioche)
4 eggs
3/4 cup of half and half (or cream and milk or just 2 tablespoons maple syrup or sugar (I used syrup)
1/4 teaspoon salt
butter as needed

Preparation

1 Whisk together the eggs, half and half, salt and maple syrup. Heat a pan on medium heat with a little butter. Dip in the pieces of bread. I let them soak in the mixture for a little because the slices of Sally Lunn were pretty thick and a little dry. Shake off the excess egg and fry on both sides until golden brown. Serve with a little butter and a lot of maple syrup. I didn't add any confectioner's sugar because they were sweet enough (although I am sure it would have made for a fancy picture).
